question: L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between O and R when counted from the right of O. Only two people sit between R and M. Only three people sit between O and N. L sits to the immediate left of Q. Who sits third to the left of S?
solution:
L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

 
• Only two people sit between O and R when counted from the right of O.
 
• Only two people sit between R and M.
 
• Only three people sit between O and N.
 
• L sits to the immediate left of Q

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8c3adb3d87f4256d98a00fee590e83534d819e94347d2ce5eb6864de71c2a79.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
